notes:
oredit 0.1.8 Windows beta

- fix(app): retain explicit UTF8 NUL matches and focus completed Grep results
- feat(app): integrate bounded Sgrep worker and editable result tabs
- fix(core): open shared files with immutable snapshots and notify external changes
- fix(view): honor Markdown wheel quantity and refine native reading styles
- feat(editor): add self C++ structure parsing and left outline sidebar
- feat(core): add isolated C++ Tree-sitter trial and benchmark evidence

Includes the C/C++ outline sidebar, Markdown wheel/style improvements, shared file opening and external-change reload, and initial Sgrep result-document integration. Folder Grep uses RE2, limits results to 2000 matching lines and reports lines over 64 KiB as unsearched. On non-cloning NTFS, dense 1 GiB private snapshots take about 2.5 seconds; the 200 ms open target is not met. The bundled worker stays idle until a search, and the existing nine-file update ZIP remains compatible.


Windows 10/11 x64 and arm64, static MSVC runtime, ten bundled license notices in six files, including Sgrep/RE2/Abseil/SIMDe. Common Release tests and Windows native self-tests pass for each published architecture. Unsigned beta. Real Microsoft IME candidate interaction, power-loss recovery, physical disk-full and the 100ms GUI-present budget remain acceptance items. macOS is not included in this Windows release.
